prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1446; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Examination revealed an effusion, tenderness along the medial joint line, and pain with valgus stress. Plain radiographs of the right knee showed no acute fracture or dislocation. Clinical findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury to the medial collateral ligament and meniscus, with suspected grade II sprain.

Over six visits, the patient was managed conservatively with rest, ice, compression, and a hinged knee brace for ambulation. A structured physical therapy program focused on quadriceps strengthening, range of motion, and gait training was initiated at the second visit and progressed as tolerated. Anti-inflammatory medication was prescribed for pain control. Swelling and pain improved steadily, and by the sixth visit the patient demonstrated near-full range of motion, stable ligamentous testing, and ability to ambulate without the brace on level surfaces. Residual mild discomfort with stairs and prolonged standing persists. Continued home exercise and activity modification were recommended, with follow-up as needed for any worsening symptoms.
